Overview

Greensboro is a city in NC with a population of 299,035. Gate City with civil rights history, four seasons, and affordable Piedmont living. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.1.
